metadata.title: Rustic Cowboy Silhouette Album Cover
useCases: Social media graphics for rural lifestyle brands

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast silhouette of a cowboy against a golden sunset, framed by a rustic wooden border with bold stencil-style typography centered over the subject.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central dark silhouette of a cowboy wearing a hat and holding a lasso, set against a glowing amber and yellow sunset background. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, weathered wooden frame, with large, white, stencil-cut sans-serif text positioned in the center foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Silhouette subject against a bright, warm light source
Text centered and overlapping the darkest part of the silhouette for legibility
Rustic wood frame containing the internal photographic scene
Lasso loops creating curved lines that lead the eye from the subject to the edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The cowboy silhouette is centrally located, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space, viewed from the back/side.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white stencil text in the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright text, moves up to the cowboy hat silhouette, and follows the lasso loops toward the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The glowing golden sky provides ample negative space around the silhouette to define its shape.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellows; extreme value contrast between the black silhouette and the bright sky.
paletteRestrictions: Monochromatic wood tones for the frame

letterConstructionRules: Stencil-cut gaps in vertical and horizontal strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars in 'A' and 'E' are severed for stencil effect
Curved strokes in 'O' and 'S' have vertical breaks
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family impact; use varying weights if secondary text is needed.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic industrial stencil look with bold weight
Matches the heavy condensed feel of the reference

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast silhouette of a cowboy on a horse from a rear-three-quarter view, holding a lasso, against a vibrant golden-hour sunset. Surround the image with a thick, rustic, weathered wood plank frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered, all-caps, bold condensed stencil text in white. Apply a subtle soft drop shadow to the text to separate it from the dark silhouette.

verificationChecks: Is the text white and stencil-style?
Is the cowboy a solid black silhouette?
Is the background a warm golden/amber gradient?
Is there a wooden frame around the entire composition?

adjustableVariables: Weathering level of the wood frame
Thickness of the stencil cuts in the font
mustRedesign: Ensure the silhouette is generic and not a specific celebrity
Do not use copyrighted wood textures

mustAchieve: Clear legibility of text against the silhouette
Rich, warm color saturation in the sky

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean stencil gaps in all letters
Verify the wood frame is seamless at the corners
Ensure the drop shadow doesn't muddy the white text
Confirm the silhouette has sharp, recognizable edges
recipe.reuseFormula: Silhouette Subject + Golden Hour Background + Rustic Wood Frame + Bold Stencil Typography
